## Why this name

- Writes the palette-bank field into a horizontal run of BG tilemap entries, columns arg2..arg3 (callers pass 2..0x1B = 26 cells, one text row)
- Address = BG base + (u8)gUnk_03000798[0x5C]*0x800 + (arg0&0x1F)*0x40, one 32-cell tilemap row
- Read-modify-write preserves flip/priority bits via AND 0x3FF while ORing (arg1&0xF)<<12
- Supersedes the earlier less specific name BgMapSetPaletteBankRun; callers are all text drawing code
